# outbound Provider

Manages Outbound gateways that replace cloud NAT gateways.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    outbound = {
      source = "suecodelabs/outbound"
    }
  }
}

# Both settings fall back to OUTBOUND_ENDPOINT and OUTBOUND_API_TOKEN.
provider "outbound" {
  endpoint = "https://api.outbound.cloudphilos.net"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Management API token. Defaults to the OUTBOUND_API_TOKEN environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Outbound API. Defaults to the OUTBOUND_ENDPOINT environment variable.
